title: Exp 1741: FR-11 Self-Distillation Memory for Continuous Self-Learning

methodology.simulation_design: 50 synthetic verification queries; true precision improves linearly from 0.35 to 0.85 modelling distillation-driven learning curve (arXiv:2601.19897)
methodology.utility_metric: mean precision across all active constraint types
methodology.distillation_loss: KL(teacher || student) where teacher=replay buffer distribution, student=normalised precision weights
